confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors come from three searches. I ran one RBA search and two cost-of-living/menu searches. Sources were Numbeo-derived figures (Expatica), Wise, MyLifeElsewhere and some hotel and bar menus. Meal, beer and coffee figures are fairly consistent across sources. Cocktail and wine vary a lot by venue. The menus I found were mostly hotel and upscale-bar prices (about 340-600 THB for cocktails, 350-500 THB for wine), so I set the anchors below those, for typical mid-range bars and restaurants. Cocktail and wine were also set relative to a restaurant draft beer of about 100-130 THB. I used an assumed rate of roughly 32-33 THB per USD for conversions, which I did not verify. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. I did not search for or inspect any accommodation listings, and they carry the most uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Bangkok's own typical prices from cost-of-living aggregators. Accommodation is judged against Bangkok's large, competitive budget and mid-range lodging market, with similar Southeast Asian capitals as a loose reference.
